global_issues.title: 30-Year Treasury Yield Tops 5.31%, Highest Since 2007
global_issues.note: Confirmed by CNBC and Bloomberg: 30-year yield hit 5.311% on August 17, 2026, highest since 2007. Still the dominant fixed-income story as of Aug 18.

global_issues.title: 50% US Tariffs on Canada Effective Wednesday as Talks Stall
global_issues.note: Confirmed: Section 338 proclamations impose 50% tariffs on a broad range of Canadian goods effective August 19, 2026 (Wednesday). As of Aug 15 reports both sides were still discussing a deal to avert the tariffs, consistent with 'talks stalled' framing, though outcome remains fluid until the deadline.

grok_report.summary: The two headline global macro items (30Y yield at 5.31%, Canada tariffs effective Wednesday) are accurate and current, but the briefing misses a critical concurrent driver of the Aug 17 selloff — reignited US-Iran tensions and rising oil prices — which materially affects the completeness of the market mood narrative. A likely data discrepancy in CRWD's closing price/percent move was also found. Sector rotation calls are broadly consistent with confirmed premarket chip-stock strength.
